title: Which of the four questions need data collection?
description: A question from the book gives four questions and asks which need data collection. The video asks of each one whether the answer must be gathered from people or places, or is a fixed fact we already know.
teaching_notes: One idea: collect data when the answer changes with the people or the place, and not when it is a fixed fact. Watch for children who tick every question that sounds like a survey.

source: Figure it Out: tick the questions that need data collection and cross the others
video_script.why: The child decides, question by question, when data has to be collected.
video_script.substitution: none: the book's own four questions
video_script.payoff_line: The first and third questions need data collection, and the second and fourth do not.

final_answer.value: tick for the first and third questions, cross for the second and fourth
final_answer.spoken: the first and third questions need data collection

names.{{NAME_8}}: decides which questions need data collection

maths_rules: Test: does the answer change with the people or the place, so it must be gathered?
Most popular TV show among classmates: gather, tick.
Date of independence: fixed fact, cross.
Water wasted in the locality: gather, tick.
Capital of India: fixed fact, cross.
video_script.design: Four question cards. Each gets a tick or a cross as the test is applied to it.
